name: vc-national-insurance
description: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines national insurance contribution reference checked for 2026. Covers ordinary employee and employer shares, current weekly and monthly earnings ceilings, earnings inclusions, registration and monthly remittance. Includes worked payroll examples and a distinction between cash salary and remuneration in kind. Uses current NIS employer guidance and the published contribution regulations, while expressly separating superseded historical rate and age provisions from current rules. Use after employment coverage is established. Special age groups, multiple employers, self-employment, benefit entitlement and the complete amendment chain require further review. Independent accountant review is pending.
